description: WorldDynamics.jl is the World Dynamics research group's Julia package for implementing and comparing global system-dynamics models. It contains World2 and World3 formulations and tutorials for composing equations, changing parameters and reproducing published scenarios. Inputs include initial stocks, parameter sets and interpolation tables; outputs are trajectories for population, capital, agriculture, resources and pollution. Coverage is global aggregate behaviour, not individual infrastructure assets. The tutorial demonstrates simulations from 1900 to 2100 with numerical resolution selected by the solver. Source is free under MIT and installable as a Julia package. A limitation is that historical model assumptions and baseline tables need checking before present-day interpretation. The package can support cross-sector resource and demand scenarios around infrastructure simulations. GCAM (model-gcam) is a related integrated-assessment resource. The JOSS paper identifies the software, and no scenario was executed during this review.
